summary: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (Model Number: PNV6-571-BQD4) is experiencing intermittent charging issues due to a malfunctioning power management system and potential conflicts between NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 and Intel Chipset drivers.
detected_fault: Power management system malfunction, possibly caused by conflicts between NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 and Intel Chipset drivers or battery calibration issues.
suggested_solution: Update BIOS to latest version (1.31), roll back NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 driver to a previous version (e.g., 465.29), and run a battery calibration test.
